name: gradient-border

frames.best_why: The whole card is crisp with the indigo edge lit at the top and the photo and copy fully visible.

tagline: Thin blue light slowly circles the edge of a dark photo card.
summary: A single navy card on black, wrapped in a slim indigo gradient outline that keeps rotating. Inside sits a rounded hillside photo, a small white heading and two lines of grey copy.
appearance: A tall dark navy rounded card floats on a black page. A thin border glows cobalt along one side and fades to slate elsewhere. Inside, a rounded photo of whitewashed houses under a pale sky sits above a small white heading and two short centred grey lines.
behaviour: A conic gradient sweeps around the card's edge in a steady four-second loop, so the bright blue segment travels from corner to corner while the photo and text stay still.
demo_content: A Santorini village photo with the heading "Create Group Effortlessly" and a chat-feature caption.
search_phrases: card with a rotating glowing border
animated gradient outline around a photo
blue glow frame for a card
moving color line on card edge
use_when: A feature or product card needs a premium animated edge to draw the eye without adding more UI.
avoid_when: The border loops forever with no pause, and the card photo, heading and caption are baked into the demo.
customise: The photo path, heading and caption are hardcoded; border colours, thickness and the four-second spin are fixed in a class string.
weight_why: One card and a single animated CSS border; no canvas, script or extra nodes.

a11y.note: The border animation loops indefinitely and ignores reduced-motion; the card has no controls, so keyboard access is not relevant.

issues: The border spin never stops and cannot be paused.
The stock village photo has nothing to do with group chats promised by the copy.
polish_why: Subtle, well judged glow around a tidy card; the stock photo and chat copy do not match.
title: Gradient Border
